title: Per-type tests are in tests/types/ and use TypeAdapter rather than BaseModel
answers: where should I add tests for a pydantic type
body:
In this PR, tests/test_types_zoneinfo.py was deleted and its tests moved to tests/types/test_zoneinfo.py. The rewritten tests build `TypeAdapter(ZoneInfo)` instead of wrapping the type in a BaseModel. They call `ta.validate_python`, `ta.dump_json` and `ta.json_schema()`, and compare `exc_info.value.errors(include_url=False)`. Because there is no model, error `loc` is `()`. The tests are fully type-annotated (`-> None`).
When you add or change tests for a single type, put them under tests/types/test_<type>.py in the same style. Do not recreate a top-level tests/test_types_*.py file.
applies: Writing tests for individual pydantic types
